title: 합동참모본부 직제 / queue:ARTICLE:12:0:00014:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 12 (Subordinate Organizations)
(1) Divisions, bureaus, and sections shall be established under general staff departments, and sections may be established under special staff departments. Where necessary, offices and groups may be established under general staff departments.
(2) Such organizations shall have respective heads, and divisions may have deputy heads or coordinators where necessary.
(3) Heads of divisions, bureaus, groups, and offices, deputy heads, and coordinators shall be general officers, civilian military employees of Grade II or higher, or field-grade officers.
(4) The Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff shall determine the establishment and allocation of duties of such organizations and positions.
